title: SCI Bioassessment Exercise (VSCI & VCPMI)
description: A reproducible teaching and analysis repository for calculating Stream Condition Index (SCI) scores using benthic macroinvertebrate data. Implements three Virginia bioassessment indices (VSCI, VCPMI +63, VCPMI -65) from a single R Markdown workflow. Includes supporting metric functions, example datasets, and a graduate-level classroom assignment. The VDEQ methodology and original metric scripts are credited to Emma Jones (Virginia DEQ).
